title: Low's handwritten note: Hippler blames EMP from nuclear testing

tellings.quote: [gasps] handwritten note by Robert Low that he talked to Hitler and Hit Hitler told him
Colonel Robert Hiper is saying that this was due to a, you know, an EMP fallout from a nuclear detonation,
tellings.difference: Comes through the 2025 Wall Street Journal article rather than Low's handwritten 1967 note.
tellings.link_reason: Both attribute the missile shutdown to Colonel Robert Hippler blaming EMP from nuclear testing or detonation.

plain: In 1967, Robert Low, a leader of the Condon Committee, a government-funded UFO study of the late 1960s, wrote a handwritten note saying that an Air Force colonel named Robert Hippler had told him the missile shutdowns of that period were caused by EMP, a burst of energy from a nuclear blast that can knock out electronics. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer who was involved in the missile events, describes the note, saying Low "talked to" Hippler and Hippler "told him" this. He also credits Roy Craig, who worked on the study. Michels comes to the same claim through a 2025 Wall Street Journal article, which he says quotes Hippler blaming "EMP fallout from a nuclear detonation." For Salas, the note matters because it shows how officials explained the shutdowns at the time.
